display.title: Episode 450: The Strange Gift (Parshas Lech Lecha)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's Lech Lecha show: Avraham Avinu's 'army' of one, Shema with a Beis Yaakov class, and the story of Nachum Ish Gamzu's box of sand.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Parshas Lech Lecha at the start of 5751, the year of wonders. Uncle Yossi teaches that Avraham Avinu went to war against the five powerful kings to rescue his nephew Lot with only his servant Eliezer; Rashi explains that the 318 soldiers are the numerical value of Eliezer's name, which means 'my G-d is my help'. With Hashem on our side we do not count horses and chariots, and Hashem protects the Jewish people in every generation. After the Hakochainik march, a second-grade class from Beis Yaakov of Boro Park recites the Shema and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time: a father tells little Yehoshua how Nachum Ish Gamzu, carrying a box of diamonds to a king, found it filled with sand, said 'this too is for good', and saw Eliyahu HaNavi turn the sand into a miraculous weapon. The show ends with a Moshiach Times magazine message, Shabbos candle-lighting time and the closing.
display.lesson: Whatever Hashem does is for the good, and with strong trust in Hashem we need no great army to win.

date.note: 'This week's sedra, Lech Lecha' at the beginning of the year Nun Aleph (5751); candle time 5:42 fits late October in New York. The weekly estimate (20 Tishrei) was two weeks early.

advisories.note: A battle against five kings; a king orders the hero imprisoned and put to death, though he is saved.
The thieving hotel keeper is put to death by the king for his crime.

privacy.note: The visiting class's teacher is named on air; no children are named.

sources_cited.note: The 318 men are Eliezer, whose name has the numerical value 318.
'Some with chariots and some with horses, but we mention the name of Hashem.'
In every generation they rise against us, and Hashem saves us.
Avraham Avinu's life was spared through many miracles.

segments.title: Lech Lecha: Avraham Avinu's Army of One
segments.summary: Avraham and Eliezer alone defeat the five kings; Rashi on the 318, and Hashem's protection of the Jewish people in every generation.

quality.notes: Narrator slip at about 24:40: the hotel keeper calls it the sand 'Rabbi Akiva' brought, meaning Nachum Ish Gamzu. Candle times and magazine ad are period pieces.
